_how: Vortex banners we design ourselves (vortexedit.py). Quest 'set' = the quest's own game fields (0iAIR2LP name, A8DEK5ob energy, 69vnphig battles, d96tuT2E exp, Rs7bCE3t zel, qp37xTDh description); 'boss' = data/custom_bosses.json; 'first_clear' / 'every_clear' = items into the gift box; 'dungeon_set' = the banner's own game fields (copied from the first quest's banner otherwise; a Research Lab banner is a trial type the Vortex list hides); 'no_continue' = gems can't be used to continue after a wipe; 'testers' = accounts (sign-in name or in-game name) that see the banner while it is tested (empty list = everyone).

set.qp37xTDh: A Vargas clad in mint green awaits. Only the strongest squads will survive.
